data.name: Luay
data.gender_notes: Luay is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Arabic root 'la-w-y' which means 'to be bright, clear, shining'. It is a name that signifies the light and joy that a child brings into the world. The name Luay carries the meaning “Bright, Clear, Shining” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Luay usually hope their child will grow to embody bright, clear, shining and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that reflects the light of Allah within the child and the joy that comes from remembering and serving Him.
data.etymology: Luay belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Bright, Clear, Shining.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Luay total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_pashto.name: لوي
in_pashto.meaning: لوي د ښکلي ځوان معنی لري
